page.overview:
Who is Albrecht von Mannheim?

The reincarnation of a Germanic warrior, Albrecht von Mannheim became the modern Wild Huntsman to fight evil in Germany.

He eventually joined the Global Guardians and sacrificed himself in battle against the evil Fain Y'onia. When the villain decided to retreat back to the mists of time, the Wild Huntsman followed him, fighting to the end. Believed gone for good, the Huntsman has since returned. He encountered Red Robin while defending a German museum from the latter. Red Robin escaped, much to the Wild Huntsman's chagrin.
